files.name: graphql-security-payloads.txt

sections.label: Nested and field-level reads: compare with the direct resolver policy
Aliases: each resolver invocation must authorize independently
Two-operation JSON batches; servers may legitimately reject batching entirely
Mutation ownership and protected input properties; use reversible test objects
Multiple named operations: selected operation must match authorization and policy checks
Persisted-query negative controls: hash is intentionally not the hash of the submitted query
Bounded depth / cost controls: run only against a configured local fixture
graphql-transport-ws subscribe messages after a valid connection_init / connection_ack exchange
GET transport negative control: URL-encoded mutation query, for endpoints supporting GET queries
